music.prompt: Dry 1970s library-music funk groove at about one hundred beats per minute, original and not any known theme: warm electric piano, muted fingered bass, brushed drums and a bright toy-piano glint. It stays light and curious, drops to a sparse bass-and-piano pulse in the middle, then a warm string line swells near the end before a final soft electric-piano chord.

sfx.prompt: a 1970s manual typewriter typing a short burst then the carriage return bell ding
a fountain pen signing a paper contract on a wooden desk, close and crisp
two heavy rubber stamps thumping down on paper, one after another
plastic toy blister packs rattling on metal pegboard hooks
soft sleigh bells and a distant department store Christmas crowd murmur
an empty cardboard box being shaken, hollow, then the lid flipping open
a vintage mechanical cash register ringing, the drawer sliding open with a bell
a cascade of coins pouring onto a pile, rich and satisfying
a heavy steel bank vault door unlocking with a deep clunk and slowly swinging open
a metal film can lid being lifted and a film reel softly spinning
